name: Chinese Atlas
desc: A detailed, interactive course in Chinese language and literature for native speakers: characters and calligraphy, modern Chinese, classical Chinese, three thousand years of literature, literary theory and world literature, and writing and reasoning.
desc_zh: 面向以中文为母语者的深入、可交互的中国语言文学课程：汉字与书法、现代汉语、古代汉语、三千年的中国文学、文学理论与外国文学，以及写作与思维。
lede: A detailed, interactive course in Chinese language and literature, written for native speakers who grew up with the language — the curriculum of a university degree in Chinese (汉语言文学): characters and calligraphy, the sounds, words and grammar of modern Chinese, classical Chinese, literature from the Book of Songs to the present day, literary theory and world literature, and clear writing and reasoning. This is a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
lede_zh: 一套深入、可交互的中国语言文学课程，写给以中文为母语、在中文环境中长大的读者，内容对应大学汉语言文学专业的课程体系：汉字与书法，现代汉语的语音、词汇与语法，古代汉语，从《诗经》到当代的中国文学，文学理论与外国文学，以及清晰的写作与思维。目前这是一个框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
foot: a free, detailed and interactive course in Chinese language and literature, written for native speakers.
foot_zh: 一套免费、详尽、可交互的中国语言文学课程，写给以中文为母语的读者。
about_lede: Chinese Atlas is a free, detailed course in the Chinese language and its literature — characters, modern and classical Chinese, literature from antiquity to today, literary theory and writing — written for native speakers who want to know their language more deeply, to read alongside university courses or on its own.
about_lede_zh: 中文图谱是一套免费、详尽的中国语言文学课程——汉字、现代汉语与古代汉语、从先秦到当代的文学、文学理论与写作——写给希望更深入地了解母语的读者，可以配合大学课程阅读，也可以单独自学。
timeline_desc: From oracle bones to the internet: three thousand years of the Chinese language and its literature.
timeline_desc_zh: 从甲骨文到互联网：汉语与中国文学的三千年。
timeline_title: Timeline of Chinese language and literature
timeline_lede: The events behind the courses: the oracle-bone inscriptions, the Book of Songs, the unification of the script under the Qin, Tang poetry and Song lyrics, the great novels, the vernacular revolution and the language reforms of the twentieth century. Coloured dots show the area; links lead to the course where the topic is taught.
timeline_lede_zh: 各门课程背后的大事：甲骨卜辞、《诗经》、秦代“书同文”、唐诗宋词、明清长篇小说、白话文运动与二十世纪的语文改革。彩色圆点表示所属领域；链接指向讲授相关内容的课程。
card_desc: Chinese language and literature for native speakers, at the level of a university degree: characters and calligraphy, modern and classical Chinese, literature from the Book of Songs to the present day, literary theory and world literature, and writing and reasoning. The curriculum is mapped out; the lessons are still to be written.
card_desc_zh: 写给以中文为母语者的中国语言文学课程，相当于大学汉语言文学专业的水平：汉字与书法、现代汉语与古代汉语、从《诗经》到当代的中国文学、文学理论与外国文学，以及写作与思维。课程体系已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
sources: The lessons are original texts that follow the standard university curriculum in Chinese language and literature and its reference works, and each course page recommends books for further reading. Classical texts are quoted from standard editions, and modern works still in copyright are quoted only briefly. This atlas is still a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
sources_zh: 课文均为原创，依据高校汉语言文学专业的通行课程体系和权威工具书编写，每门课程页面都推荐了延伸阅读的书目。古代作品依据通行的权威版本引用，仍在版权保护期内的现当代作品只作简短引用。本图谱目前还只是框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。

page_desc: Every definition and rule in the atlas, with its statement and a link to the lesson.
图谱中的每一条定义和规则，附有表述和指向相应课文的链接。
page_lede: Every numbered definition and rule in the atlas with its exact statement. Follow a link to read the explanation, the examples around it and the exercises that use it.
图谱中每一条带编号的定义和规则及其准确表述。点击链接即可阅读相应的解释、相关例子以及用到它的练习。
about_definition: Clear definitions of the terms we use, numbered so they can be referred to.
对所用术语的清晰定义，带编号以便引用。
about_theorem: Rules of the language — of grammar, characters, sound and metre — stated plainly, with an explanation of when they apply and where they have exceptions.
用平实的语言陈述语言的规则——语法、文字、语音与格律——并解释它们何时适用、有哪些例外。
about_example: Worked analyses of sentences, characters, poems and passages, with every step explained.
对句子、汉字、诗词和篇章的分析示例，每一步都讲清楚。
about_intuition: The idea behind a rule or a reading, in plain words.
用平实的话讲清楚规则或解读背后的道理。
report: If you find an error, please report it on %s, noting the chapter and the number of the rule, example or exercise.
如果发现错误，欢迎在 %s 上反馈，并注明所在章节以及规则、例子或练习的编号。

areas.label: Characters
areas.blurb: How Chinese characters were created and how they changed, from oracle bones to standard simplified characters, and how to write them well.
areas.blurb_zh: 汉字的产生与演变——从甲骨文到规范简化字——以及怎样把字写好。

areas.label: Modern Chinese
areas.blurb: Modern standard Chinese described precisely — its sounds, words, grammar and rhetoric — together with the science of language and the dialects of China.
areas.blurb_zh: 精确描写现代汉语共同语的语音、词汇、语法与修辞，以及语言学的基本理论和中国的方言。

areas.label: Classical Chinese
areas.blurb: Reading classical Chinese: its words and grammar, the culture it takes for granted, the sounds of earlier Chinese, and the history of the language.
areas.blurb_zh: 读懂文言：古代汉语的词汇与语法、古书默认的文化常识、古音，以及汉语的历史。

areas.label: Classical literature
areas.blurb: Chinese literature from the Book of Songs to Dream of the Red Chamber, period by period, and the forms and metre of classical poetry.
areas.blurb_zh: 从《诗经》到《红楼梦》，分时期讲中国古代文学，以及古典诗词的体式与格律。

areas.label: Modern literature
areas.blurb: Chinese literature since the New Culture Movement: modern and contemporary fiction, poetry, essays and drama.
areas.blurb_zh: 新文化运动以来的中国文学：现当代的小说、诗歌、散文与戏剧。

areas.label: Theory & world literature
areas.blurb: How literature works and how it has been judged, in classical Chinese criticism and modern theory, and the literatures of the world.
areas.blurb_zh: 文学如何运作、如何被评判——中国古代文论与现代文学理论——以及世界各国的文学。

areas.label: Writing & reasoning
areas.blurb: Clear thinking and clear writing: narrative and description, logic and argument, practical and official documents, and academic papers.
areas.blurb_zh: 清晰地思考，清楚地写作：记叙与描写、逻辑与议论、应用文与公文，以及学术论文。
